SECTIONSOverviewSpecificationsSupportDiscover
XT Pro UltraSpacious, Powerful & AffordableWith new hardware releases demanding more cooling capacity and internal space, the XT-series is designed to deliver just that. And it delivers extremely good value. The length and width of the chassis easily fit even the largest graphics cards with space to spare for cable management. Cooling has been optimized with up to 10x 120 mm fan locations, support for 140 mm fans, and dedicated radiator space in the top of the chassis.
The XT-Series further innovates to bring support for the latest mainboards that host hidden connectors at the rear to unlock that zero-cable setup. The graphics card also benefits from 3x 120 mm fan locations on the mid-plate that provide direct cooling.

SupportDocumentationManualFAQGeneralWhere do I find the product manual?Where do I find the product manual?Most products have their product manual in the accessory box or directly printed on the packaging if the installation only contains a few steps. For the latest version, we always recommend checking the online manual, which can be found under the support section of the product page.
How do I know my GPU will fit?How do I know my GPU will fit?Because there are many different GPU sizes, it is always recommended to check the GPU clearance beforehand. If the length of the GPU fits within the clearance numbers, the GPU should fit neatly. This information can be found within the ‘Specifications’ section on the product page.
What can I find on the Phanteks website?What can I find on the Phanteks website?The Phanteks website provides product information, specifications, features, compatibility information, manuals, downloads, and other resources for Phanteks products.
Can I purchase Phanteks products directly from the website?Can I purchase Phanteks products directly from the website?The Phanteks website is designed to provide product information and support. Products are available through authorized retailers and distributors. If you live within the USA, please visit our official online store: phanteks.store
Where can I find information about a specific Phanteks product?Where can I find information about a specific Phanteks product?Visit the product page for the product you are interested in. Product pages contain available specifications, features, compatibility information, downloads, and other relevant product details.
Where can I find compatibility information?Where can I find compatibility information?Compatibility information is provided on the corresponding product page where available. If you cannot find the information you need, contact our support team.
How can I find the dimensions of a product?How can I find the dimensions of a product?Product dimensions and other physical specifications can be found on the individual product page under the ‘Specifications’ section.
Where can I find information about discontinued products?Where can I find information about discontinued products?Information for discontinued products, also called ‘End of Life’ EoL for short, may remain available on the Phanteks website for reference. Availability of documentation and support may vary by product.
Where can I find the manual for my Phanteks product?Where can I find the manual for my Phanteks product?Product manuals can be found on the individual product page under the ‘Support’ section.

Why can’t I find a particular product at my local retailer?Why can’t I find a particular product at my local retailer?Product availability varies by region and retailer. If a product is not currently available, check other authorized retailers or contact the appropriate regional Phanteks support team.
Where can I find an authorized Phanteks retailer?Where can I find an authorized Phanteks retailer?Use the Where to Buy section on the Phanteks website to find available retailers and distributors in your region.
Can’t find the answer you’re looking for?
Contact us through the SUPPORT button in the bottom right corner of the website.
